caption: The drawing displays three representations of the same cap against a plain, off-white background. The main object, located in the upper center of the composition, is a brown cap depicted in color. The cap is decorated with a blue embroidered pattern consisting of stylized leaves and ribbon forms that encircle both the top and sides of the cap. The cap has a soft, creased texture, and a short, protruding brim. Below the colored cap, there are two black-and-white outline sketches of the same cap shown from different angles. The sketch on the left shows a top-down perspective, emphasizing the circular embroidery on the crown. The sketch on the right shows a side view, again highlighting the embroidered pattern on the cap's side. Both sketches are drawn with thin, dark lines, and include some hatching for shading detail. The background is otherwise empty and unadorned.
title: House Cap
